description: Build with Mzizi: the seven Mzizi agent skills (@nyuchi/mzizi-skills 0.11.0) in four categories: dev (digital-hygiene, progress-report), design (mzizi-design), language (mzizi-language) and build (mzizi-roots, mzizi-backend, discoverability), and the Mzizi MCP at mcp.mzizi.dev (free, no account; sign-in only for the Fundi tools). The 21-family palette, Mzizi Roots components in Rust first, the Mzizi language, the Ubuntu doctrine, and how every agent works (disk hygiene and progress reports). Owned and operated by Mzizi; live at mzizi.dev.

interface.longDescription: Build with Mzizi, the programming language and the components that support it. The plugin carries the seven Mzizi agent skills (@nyuchi/mzizi-skills 0.11.0) in four categories: dev (digital-hygiene, progress-report), design (mzizi-design), language (mzizi-language) and build (mzizi-roots, mzizi-backend, discoverability), and connects the Mzizi MCP server at https://mcp.mzizi.dev/mcp: the registry (components, Rust first), the brand tokens, the DNA-helix architecture, the Ubuntu doctrine, the skills and the docs. Every tool is free with no account except mzizi_fundi and mzizi_report_issue, which act as your Mzizi console user and need sign-in. The language is a Phase 0 prototype: the mzizi-language skill says what it can and cannot do today.
